title: Phase 1 — Giao thức MVP (chưa có Rust)
summary: Phase 1 MVP spec for a Lead→Dev→QA protocol: project routing via projects_map.json, role prompts, .plan.md template, and acceptance tests.
scope: project routing with Vietnamese name matching
notes: Medium confidence. No filename/path convention matches ADR/PRD/SPEC/RFC. Content signals: JSON data schema (projects_map.json), role input/output contract table, file templates, and acceptance-test table point to SPEC. Competing PRD signals (Mục tiêu/Phạm vi goals, acceptance-test table) are present but the content is implementation-level (schema, script names, CLI flags), so SPEC wins. No Status field, so not ADR. Output filename uses placeholder suffix '-UNHASHED' because the SHA-256 path hash could not be computed with the available tools (Read/Write/Grep/Glob only); the synthesizer must match on source_path, not the filename.
